title: When the Wolf Burns Revisited
author: Casper Zhou
blurb: August Eriksen, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
